messages:
zoe: quick heads-up: deploying routing-lite v3 in ~7m. plan to use a fast-toggle FF with a short quantile ramp + emergency drain command.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @zoe at 2026-04-18 19:02 UTC. runbook: /runbooks/routing-lite-v3 (link).

matt: propose tiny ramp: q0-10 (canary, 2m), q0-35 (10m), q0-75 (15m), then open. region order: us-west -> us-east -> eu.

lara: safety gates: p99 +220ms sustained 4m -> immediate disable; error-rate +0.6% 5m -> disable; queue depth >1400 -> drain. alerts to #eng-oncall.

sre-oncall: auto-drain action: disable flag + scale-down new pods and shift traffic to route-v2. i'll wire circuit into deploy pipeline.

zoe: exact fast commands: `rbctl ff set routing_lite_v3.enabled false --note "safety-drain"` and `rbctl deploy promote routing-service --to-tag route-v2` or via ops-bot `/ops ff off routing_lite_v3 --urgent`.

ops-bot: note: `/ops ff off routing_lite_v3 --urgent` will create audit and post runbook link. CLI preferred if CI is degraded.

matt: pinned binary: `rbctl ff set routing_lite_v3.meta version=v3.0.2 --sticky` to prevent mid-roll auto-updates.

zoe: proceeding. i'll post release note 2m before start. matt and lara will monitor first 30m.

deploy-bot: deploy started by @zoe at 5032100123

deploy-bot: Canary enabled -> routing_lite_v3 quantile 0-10 in us-west (~1% traffic)

lara: canary p99 +25ms, p95 stable. moving to q0-35 after 3m.

ops-bot: reaction :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: circuit armed. will auto-disable on thresholds and page PD.

matt: stage promotions green; opening to full after soak. will keep enhanced alerts for 2h.

zoe: release note: "routing-lite v3 rolled with quantile ramp, version pinned v3.0.2, circuit-breaker and emergency drain enabled."

ops-bot: audit: /audit/flags/routing_lite_v3/5032100123

lara: closing thread. good job team."
